title: The rational Hodge conjecture for products of K3 surfaces
summary: Withdrawal notice: The proof relies on an adaptation of the flawed stabilization-trace construction in Algebraicity of Weil classes on split abelian eightfolds. The sign error in that construction prevents the required signed-double-point cancellation. The resulting gap leaves this paper's claimed rational Hodge theorem for products of projective K3 surfaces unproved. This withdrawal concerns the proof; it does not assert that the mathematical statement…

discussion.title: Rigidity, flexibility, and a sign error
discussion.author: Yanki Lekili, Nick Sheridan
discussion.text: The documents [OAI26a, OAI26b, OAI26c] claimed to prove cases of the Hodge conjecture via homological mirror symmetry, before being withdrawn by OpenAI. We discuss the source of the error (but do not analyse the rest of the argument).
